summary.en: Open Member Question references through Better Sidebar Files from a receiver-owned hidden Workspace copy.
summary.zh: 通过 Better Sidebar Files 打开成员提问参考材料，并使用接收方自有的隐藏 Workspace 副本。

compatibilityExceptions.reason: The planner follows shared Client Runtime packages, but Mobile does not compose the Web member-question plugin or Better Sidebar Files path.
The planner follows shared lockfile and aggregate build inputs; receiver-owned document cache and Files opening are Host Web/Desktop-only and no Platform image or deployment input changes.
